Game Overview

At its heart, Stickman Neon Motorcycle Racing is a sports game about race through a vibrant neon world as a daring stickman biker. Navigate laser-filled roads and dodge traffic with ease. Collect power-ups to turbocharge your ride and outpace time itself. Experience heart-racing excitement, master intuitive controls, and break your own records in this electrifying motorcycle adventure.
